title: 第19章 步入非人名录武籍求追读第20章 大方回家
content_zh:
这一觉，李青山睡得很舒服。
他好似回到了母胎的羊水之中，全身被包裹着，轻飘飘，暖洋洋...
直到外边传来闷响。
他才猛地睁眼起身，右手撑地，想要起身。
明明没用什么力气。
人已经飞起来了。
李青山被这突兀大增的力量彻底惊醒了。
人在空中，他下意识看向府门，视野好似卡帧了一般，让他在短短时间，不仅看清了来人，还有空打量细节。
回来的人，正是消失了快一个月的王孝。
此时的王孝，身形枯瘦许多，全靠宽大的骨架子撑着，双眼布满血丝，气息萎靡。
要不是骨相还在。
李青山几乎以为这是某个要嘎的瘾君子。
飞至几乎要与府院的三米墙壁等高，他的身形才在重力作用下，重新下落。
李青山连忙调整身形，才没砸在地面，却也显得狼狈，有些难以掌控突然暴涨的力气，一举一动，都产生了强大的破坏力，将身上衣服都崩成了一条条。
不仅是力气。
嗅觉变化也很大。
落地之后，李青山不敢轻易再动弹，周围的各种气味，却止不住地涌入鼻腔。
最强烈的，是一种很难形容的腐臭味。
味道的来源，正是距离他十余米远的王孝。
李青山先是奇怪王孝为何会变成这样，随后又惊奇自己的视力、反射神经、力量、嗅觉、甚至还有一开始的听觉之类，变化之大，堪称脱胎换骨。

这...
李青山呆愣住了。
他闭上眼睛，感受身体，惊愕发现，不过是睡了一觉，他已然完成了脱胎换骨。
力量、反应速度、五感...
虽然还没实验过，但非人之处，已经显现。
...
李青山惊愕。
刚刚回来的王孝，更加惊愕。
他瞪大一双充满血丝的眸子，声音嘶哑沉闷：“你居然已经全身淬炼了一遍，完成了一次脱胎换骨？”
这合理吗？
他当年，可是花了三年时间，才磨完一次的啊！
李青山回过神。
他挠挠头：“这不是很正常吗，我虽然意志力比不得你们，但韧性还是有的。”
经历了淬炼身子的痛苦，李青山学会了尊重每一个肉身境的武人。
这些人，真是意志力堪比钢铁的狠人。
他一个开挂卡bug的，不如也。
见着李青山一副理所当然的模样，王孝嘴唇蠕动两下，想说些什么，最后只能憋出一句：“我不是让你慢慢磨嘛，太急了，容易伤神...”
他说的磨，是以年为单位的啊。
不然就那脱胎换骨的痛苦，几个人能受得了？
content_en:
This time, Li Qingshan slept very comfortably.
He seemed to have returned to the amniotic fluid of his mother's womb, his whole body was wrapped, light and warm...
Until there was a muffled sound outside.
He suddenly opened his eyes and stood up, placing his right hand on the ground, trying to get up.
It obviously didn't take much effort.
People are already flying.
Li Qingshan was completely awakened by this sudden increase in power.
While he was in the air, he subconsciously looked towards the door of the mansion. His field of vision seemed to be stuck. In a short period of time, he could not only clearly see the person coming, but also have time to look at the details.
The person who came back was Wang Xiao, who had disappeared for almost a month.
At this time, Wang Xiao was much thinner, supported entirely by his broad frame. His eyes were bloodshot and his breath was weak.
If the bones weren't still there.
Li Qingshan almost thought he was a drug addict.
After flying to almost the same height as the three-meter wall of the courtyard, his figure fell back down again under the influence of gravity.
Li Qingshan quickly adjusted his body shape so that he did not hit the ground, but he still looked embarrassed. It was difficult to control the sudden surge of strength. Every move produced powerful destructive power, and the clothes on his body collapsed into strips.
Not just strength.
The sense of smell also changes greatly.
After landing, Li Qingshan did not dare to move easily, but the various smells around him couldn't stop pouring into his nose.
The strongest thing was an indescribable rancid smell.
The source of the smell was Wang Xiao, who was more than ten meters away from him.
Li Qingshan first wondered why Wang Xiao became like this, and then he was surprised that his vision, reflexes, strength, sense of smell, and even his hearing at the beginning had changed so much that he could be called a completely different person.
This...
Li Qingshan was stunned.
He closed his eyes, felt his body, and was shocked to find that after just one sleep, he had already completely transformed.
Strength, reaction speed, five senses...
Although it has not been tested yet, its inhuman qualities have already been revealed.
...
Li Qingshan was shocked.
Wang Xiao, who had just returned, was even more shocked.
His bloodshot eyes widened, and his voice was hoarse and dull: "You have actually tempered your whole body and completed a rebirth?"
Is this reasonable?
Back then, it took him three years to polish it off once!
Li Qingshan came to his senses.
He scratched his head: "Isn't this normal? Although my willpower is not as strong as yours, I still have resilience."
After experiencing the pain of tempering his body, Li Qingshan learned to respect every martial artist in the physical realm.
These people are really ruthless people with willpower as strong as steel.
It's not as good as him who exploits the card bug.
Seeing Li Qingshan's matter-of-fact look, Wang Xiao moved his lips twice, trying to say something, but in the end he could only hold back one sentence: "Didn't I ask you to grind slowly? If you are too hasty, you will easily get nervous..."
The grind he mentioned was measured in years.
Otherwise, how many people can bear the pain of being reborn?
